_comment: M5 REJECT demo variant: byte-identical to limits.json except max_order_notional_units, tightened to 1000000 so the SAME calendar-spread stream that is APPROVED under limits.json is REJECTED here on per-order notional (AEGIS-123, reason_code kMaxOrderNotional) with zero adapter submission and zero exchange order, proving AEGIS-120's mandatory risk path end to end from the production CLI. It previously tightened order_quantity_limits to 0 instead; the M5 input-integrity repair (cpp/participant/risk/risk_limits.hpp, N2) correctly made a non-positive max_order_quantity_units a load-time error, and because the demo strategy proposes exactly 1 unit and the cap is compared strictly (quantity > cap), no VALID positive quantity cap can reject a 1-unit order. Notional is the narrowest real control that still rejects this stream without weakening that invariant or changing the strategy. AEGIS-121's own reject-or-resize boundary evidence is unaffected: it comes from the C++ boundary tests recorded in experiments/evidence/AEGIS-121/max_order_quantity.json, not from this demo.
